summary: Child→User Preview feature fully verified. All 14 backend tests pass. Frontend UI shows Child→User Assistent panel for possible_real_customer candidates with all required elements: email input, name input, preview button, preview card with restore_ready status, and confirm button. API returns expected values: Anuar and Emma previews return restore_ready=true with new emails; Albin preview with existing alias returns restore_ready=false with existing_user set. No regression in existing features (review enrichment, filters, bulk restore, history).

issues: Cookie banner overlays lower-right area (known infrastructure caveat, does not block functionality)
